content.value: Make sentence with thę following structures using the words given in brackets:
. (i) Subj. + Intransitive Verb + Adv. of manner. (write as verb)
(ii) Why + Subi. + Verb + Adv. of manner + Verb + Adj. complement. (come and is as verb)
(ii) Subj. + that + Verb + Adv. of place + Verb + Object. (is and shock as verb)
(iv) Since + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of manner, Subj. + Verb + Adv. of place. (work and succeed as verb)
(v) Not only + Subj. + but also + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of place. (Attend as verb)
(vi) Subj. + Verb + Object + as + Subj. + Verb + Object. (complete and suggest as verb)
(vii) Subj. + Verb + So + Adj. complement + that + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of place. (is and shine as verb)
